environment.pi_config: owner's own ~/.pi/agent (pi-lens, pi-subagents, pi-mcp-adapter, pi-web-access, pi-multiagent, zstack extension)

before.final_text: startup banner polluted the turn's final text
before.cancel: tool card stayed pending; reload re-ran the cancelled sleep 60 (66.7s to first chunk)
before.history: panel call failed at 15.0s with RPC deadline exceeded; pi-acp session/list took 15.7s for 1350 sessions
before.errors: 429 retries became assistant text; turn ended end_turn with no answer and last_error null
before.events: 20+ tool_call_update events per bash call; 40+ per-token thought chunks for one sentence
before.hero: new-session model select could stay disabled
before.approval: Pi wrote files with zero permission requests and no UI notice

fixes: filter the adapter banner by session/new _meta.piAcp.startupInfo plus its shape; keep it out of reply and events
record provider retry chatter as status notes, not assistant text
an empty prompt answer now records an error event and last_error
on a cancelled turn, unfinished tool calls receive a terminal event
panel history deadline 35 s, daemon list timeout 25 s; failed refresh falls back to the last good list
collapse repeated tool_call_update title growth into meaningful changes
rebuild the new-session settings when write capability changes
show Pi's approval/MCP limits in the session meta and the new-session note
merge adjacent message/thought chunks (512 bytes or 150 ms) instead of one event per token

after.first_chunk: answer text first; no banner; final_text clean
after.final_verification: status idle, stop end_turn, final text 最终验证通过, 6.2s
after.cancel: terminal tool state (failed/cancelled), no pending card
after.error_path: stub 429 produced retry notes in Chinese and the error 这一轮没有回答
after.history: 15.5s then listed Agent 里之前的会话 (native pi session visible); cache/fallback in place
after.tool_events: one tool_call + 2 tool_call_update for a bash call (was 20+)
after.hero: select enabled after load; note explains Pi's direct execution
after.text_events: one thinking event and one answer event for a real turn (was 40+ thought chunks)

upstream_limits: pi-acp stores ACP mcpServers but does not forward them to pi, so mesh_send is unavailable inside Pi sessions; the panel now says so
after a cancelled turn, reloading the conversation can make the model retry the unfinished tool call; HarnessMesh cannot rewrite pi's session history
provider 429 retries are emitted by pi itself; HarnessMesh surfaces the final empty answer as an error instead of success
